scope: Original art and isolated staging canvas; no game runtime tested

findings.direction: All16 poses retain down/left/right/up row facing. The rear head lowers behind back without inventing a side face/beak.
findings.anatomy: Single short beak/head, two folded wings, short fan tail, two scaly supporting feet. Far toes partly occluded in low side poses; no extra leg or detached wing.
findings.phase: Ready -> head/neck lower -> lower ground peck -> upright swallow/recovery; feet remain grounded and head/neck carry the motion. Body is slightly crouched in ready versus idle.
findings.footAnchor: Manual source foot-pair/support projection per frame. Beak tip in down/side contact and rear tail extend below the foot projection; lowest image pixel would be the wrong anchor.
findings.scale: Existing v334 .045 crow scale preserved; source side silhouettes remain comparable to idle. Native16 silhouettes lower and recover, and beak/tail direction remains distinct. Tiny toes/feather detail do not all survive16px.
findings.alpha: Actual neutral-background alpha composites show complete bodies without neighbour feathers, opaque floor, cast light or baked food/carcass/victim.
findings.item: One four-feather blue-black bundle with separate shafts, complete tips and vanes.16/32px fit samples shown; finer barb detail survives mainly at larger UI size.
findings.limits: Source/canvas review does not establish actual core consumption, map lighting/occlusion, cue interruption or release readiness. Main integration remains inactive.
